Only actively exploited vulnerabilities with CVSS 9 or higher that can be attacked over the network without login, where CISA has not said the attack is hard to automate. New vulnerabilities outside the catalog need an EPSS of at least 70 %. About two a week.

Actively exploited vulnerabilities with CVSS 9 or higher that can be attacked over the network without login, plus exploited ones used for ransomware or flagged by CERT-SE. New vulnerabilities need CVSS 9+ and an EPSS of at least 40 %. Two or three a week.
Everything actively exploited with CVSS 8 or higher, or 7 and higher if reachable over the network without login. New vulnerabilities need CVSS 9+ and an EPSS of at least 20 %. Several a week.
Only vulnerabilities in what you turn on here are shown and notified. The platform is read from the NVD\'s list of affected products (CPE), or from the vendor and product name.
Only when the app is opened
Android runs the check in the background, also when the app is closed. If your phone limits background apps, set PatchNow to \"Unrestricted\" battery use.
Notify when something new becomes critical
Quiet at night (22:00–07:00), notify at the first check after 07:00 instead
Notifications are turned off for PatchNow in Android.
Swipe left on a vulnerability to hide a vendor you don\'t use.
PatchNow follows the phone\'s language (English or Swedish). You can choose another language for this app in Android settings.
PatchNow shows vulnerabilities that are being exploited or are about to be, so that you can skip the noise and patch what matters first.
Sources: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, the NVD (NIST), EPSS from FIRST (first.org/epss) and CERT-SE. PatchNow is not affiliated with any of them.
This product uses data from the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.
The assessment is a help for prioritising, not a guarantee. Always check the vendor\'s advisory.
